description: Implementation of deprecated type properties handling and conversion functions in the Aten core library for PyTorch, including functions to obtain tensors and storage from pointers and copying tensors with specific device options.

classes.name: DeprecatedTypeProperties
classes.description: A class providing deprecated methods to handle tensor and storage conversions from legacy pointers, as well as tensor copying with device considerations.

methods.name: Tensor unsafeTensorFromTH(void * th_pointer,bool retain) const
methods.description: Converts a raw pointer to a Tensor object, marked as unsafe due to potential lifetime issues.

methods.name: Storage unsafeStorageFromTH(void * th_pointer,bool retain) const
methods.description: Converts a raw pointer to a Storage object, marked as unsafe for similar reasons.

methods.name: Tensor copy(const Tensor & src,bool non_blocking,std::optional<Device> to_device) const
methods.description: Creates a copy of the source tensor, optionally on a specified device and non-blocking.

ctags.name: copy
ctags.pattern: /^Tensor DeprecatedTypeProperties::copy(const Tensor & src, bool non_blocking, std::optional<Devic/
